standard_faultlist_mapping: exact normalized object path; generated-but-unmapped is fatal
post_outcome_policy: Attempts>0 + U8/U9 => PC detected; Attempts>0 without U8/U9 (normally U1) => PC not detected; NC/NO/NS explicit zero-attempt testability outcomes

zoix_status_semantics.U1: Z01X pending/default status; with Attempts>0 and no U8/U9 it is analysis-level PC-not-detected, with Attempts==0 it is unresolved
zoix_status_semantics.U7: legacy no-PC-difference status accepted only for backward compatibility; v1.1.1 does not emit it

seed_variant_policy: All workloads use seed_variant=SEED%3; deterministic workloads vary operands/data/branch constants while preserving workload semantics; interrupt/DMA/debug also vary timing.

ranking.primary_definition: sum PC-detected fault executions / (candidate requested SA faults * workload_seed_cells)
ranking.peak_score: max per-workload mean overall PC impact across seeds

baseline_fingerprint_audit.stimulus_source: realized PMEM image + initial DMEM image + realized external stimulus schedule; raw seed label excluded
baseline_fingerprint_audit.pc_trace_source: cycle-by-cycle golden frontend_0.pc after reset release; raw seed label excluded
baseline_fingerprint_audit.interpretation: different stimulus hashes prove non-duplicate realized variants; equal PC hashes are allowed and mean different stimuli converged to the same PC trajectory
